answer: The garden panel is drawn blind, the fable escrow settles at close, and hollow lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 20% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 452 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
